fact: On 28 September 2026 a ten-day multisectoral workshop opened at Nkok to prepare the national civil registration assizes and make the national civil registration centre operational, under the World Bank-backed Gabon Digital programme, to build a digital, biometric, centralised civil registration system.
title: ÉTAT CIVIL : LE GABON ENGAGE UNE RÉFORME STRUCTURELLE POUR MODERNISER SON SYSTÈME NATIONAL
